US and Iran exchange strikes amid escalating Gulf tensions

The United States and Iran have engaged in a series of strikes and retaliatory actions in the Gulf region, raising concerns about a potential escalation of conflict. Both nations have accused each other of violating peace agreements and threatening further military action. The exchanges have led to heightened tensions and warnings from both sides, with some reports indicating attacks on targets in Bahrain and Kuwait.
